source.detail: Values were read from frontend/ in the graph-ted checkout. Groups that were not named in that source are unchanged.

provenance.color.brand: BRANDING.md brand teal #009999. 3.49:1 on white, so it is not used for text.
provenance.color.interactive: BRANDING.md interactive #007A7A. Header bar and light-mode link text. 5.17:1 with white.
provenance.color.dark_link: BRANDING.md dark-scheme links #33CCCC. 8.16:1 on slate #1e2129. #007A7A on that background is 3.12:1.
provenance.color.dark.slate_reference: BRANDING.md names Material slate as #1e2129 for the contrast check. The dark scheme keeps Material's slate background.
provenance.layout.navbar_height: App Navbar.tsx: py={1} (2 x 0.25rem) around the 72px mark plus a 1px bottom border = 81px. Matches the docs brief.
provenance.layout.logo_height: App BrandLogo.tsx: the nav variant is h="72px".
provenance.font.text: App fonts.body token, copied as written. Inter is self-hosted here; "Inter Variable" is the app's @fontsource-variable family name and falls through to it.
provenance.font.code: Self-hosted JetBrains Mono already used by these docs. Not claimed as an app token.
provenance.focus: Header controls use white on #007A7A (5.17:1). Content focus uses the scheme link color.
provenance.radius: Chakra UI 3.26.0 defaultConfig, read from frontend/node_modules/@chakra-ui/react. The app theme extends defaultConfig and does not override this group. Buttons and inputs use l2 (the app's 4px control radius); code blocks and admonitions use md, the radius app panels set.
provenance.spacing: Chakra UI 3.26.0 defaultConfig, read from frontend/node_modules/@chakra-ui/react. The app theme extends defaultConfig and does not override this group. Exposed as --gt-space-* variables.
provenance.shadow: Chakra UI 3.26.0 defaultConfig, read from frontend/node_modules/@chakra-ui/react. The app theme extends defaultConfig and does not override this group. Semantic shadows, light and dark, with color references resolved the way Chakra emits them (color-mix).
provenance.icon_set: frontend/package.json depends on react-icons (imported families, most used first: fi, fa, lu, bs, hi2). No SVGs are vendored, so Material's built-in icons stay in the docs.
provenance.button: Chakra UI 3.26.0 button recipe, default size md: h, px, and textStyle resolved through the spacing, text-style, and font-size tokens.
provenance.layout.root_font_size: App globalCss html fontSize. Material's root is 125%, so app rem lengths are written to the stylesheet in px at this size.

font.text: "Inter Variable", Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
